title: Non-Western TCC Perspectives
description: No sources from Non-Western TCC national perspectives (France, Italy, Spain). Their motivations, constraints, and national caveats are undocumented in the current corpus.

title: Maritime Task Force Documentation
description: UNIFIL's Maritime Task Force is the UN's only naval peacekeeping component. Dedicated documentation on its operations, mandate interpretation, and lessons is absent from the corpus.

title: Lebanese and Arab Perspectives
description: The corpus is heavily weighted toward Israeli institutional sources and Western academic analysis. Lebanese, Arab, and Shia community perspectives on UNIFIL are significantly underrepresented.

title: Freedom of Movement of UNIFIL
description: Many sources mention lack of freedom of movement of the mission. Would be interesting to hear UN perspective on how this was handled and how much it affected mandate implementaiton

title: Quality of Peacekeepers
description: Assaf Orion (2016) points to diffence in quality of troops of UNIFIL I and UNIFIL II.

title: Force Mobile Reserve
description: Described as a key innovation of UNIFIL for force protection

title: ISR
description: Some sources indicate UNIFIL as a pioneer in usage of surveillance ground radar and night goggles, starting from the inception of the mission and anticipating ISR debates by decades.

title: De-mining
description: Sources seem to indicate incredible work done by UNIFIL to de-mine Lebanese territory. Need to find more information / statistics.
